keywords: Linear programming problem 2.Simplex method 3.Matrices and its operations 4.Linear equations and sweep method
educationalGoal: With the development of computers, the theory of mathematical optimization has rapidly evolved. In this lecture, students learn the fundamentals of linear programming and the simplex method, and learn "matrices and their operations" and "scavenging methods" as peripheral knowledge.
advice: In this course, students will study the following - Linear programming problems - Simplex method - Matrices and their operations - Sweep method Advice for students - This course is the foundation of linear algebra, so students should aim for an ideal level of achievement. - Students are expected to achieve an ideal level of achievement in this course. - Students are expected to prepare for and review each lesson. - Each assignment should be written with detailed explanations and mathematical formulas, and the process of working on the assignment should be described in a logical manner.
requiredKnowledge: Since the main subject is the four arithmetic operations on integers and fractions, knowledge of mathematics beyond high school is not required, but the skill to avoid calculation errors is necessary. The ability to incorporate new knowledge is also necessary.

activityGoals.body: Solve bivariate linear programming problems by drawing graphs.
Understand how to solve linear programming problems using the simplex method.
Understand the concept of sequences and their operations.
To be able to solve linear programming problems by the simplex method using the sweep method.
Understand basic mathematical vocabulary in English and be able to respond to questions in English.
Attend each class, make efforts to understand the contents of the class, and complete reports and homework assig

achievementLevels.standard: - Draw graphs and solve bivariate linear programming problems correctly. - Understand how to solve linear programming problems using the simplex method. - Understand the concept of matrices and their operations. - The student should be able to solve linear programming problems by the simplex method using the sweep-and-sweep method. - To be able to complete reports, homework assignments, and exercises.
